newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL DEFENDER RUDDOCK FINED FOR LYING TO POLICE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL DEFENDER RUDDOCK FINED FOR LYING TO POLICE.

text.p: Liverpool central defender Neil Ruddock was fined 300 pounds ($470) on Thursday for telling "blatant lies" to police after a friend crashed his sports car.
Southport magistrates found Ruddock guilty of obstructing police after he claimed the Porsche 911 had been stolen. In fact, his friend had been driving the car when it crashed in January.
Ruddock was also told to pay 200 pounds ($310) in costs.
